g.title: service_dependencies
g.text: vigild: when does service S start?

g.title: cluster_deps
g.text: for each dependency D of S

g.title: cluster_cascade
g.text: while S runs: requires stop cascade

g.title: queued
g.text: requires on a disabled D: load warning

g.title: l_after
g.text: S starts after D is ready (ordering only)
S waits for D, and is stopped when D stops for good
not started by autostart; only by hand
started by its cron schedule, not by autostart
the other way round: D stops after S has exited
